children: AI infrastructure plans are prompting Citi to raise its spending assumptions, while the bank also sees room for substantial expansion in the company's cloud business. Citi's updated forecasts follow Alibaba's push to expand data-center capacity to more than 20 gigawatts by 2032.

For fiscal 2027 through fiscal 2029, Citi now projects capital expenditures of 258 billion yuan, 283 billion yuan and 282 billion yuan, respectively. The estimates reflect the expected cost of building out computing infrastructure to support Alibaba's growing AI operations.
Citi maintained its $190 price target on Alibaba (BABA) while retaining its Buy rating.

Citi analyst Alicia Yap estimates Alibaba's external AI cloud revenue could reach $168 billion by fiscal 2033. That forecast implies a 40% compound annual growth rate from fiscal 2026 and depends on continued expansion of AI computing capacity.

Alibaba has also introduced the Zhenwu V900 accelerator and outlined plans for much larger AI models, adding to its broader effort to develop chips, models and cloud infrastructure internally. Reuters reported that the new accelerator is expected to enter mass production in early 2027.

title: Citi Revamps Alibaba Stock Forecast
